opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot email
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up its indicators on World Bank Open Data and its Wikipedia article, then write an email to a given recipient titled '<Country> macro snapshot' with GDP, growth, population, capital and currency.
steps: Open data.worldbank.org and type the country name in the main search box
Select the country suggestion and read GDP, GDP growth and population (most recent year)
Open Wikipedia, search the country name and open the article
Note the capital and currency (with ISO code) from the infobox
Open the New message compose form
Enter the recipient email in To
Enter body 'Hi <name>, <Country>: GDP US$<gdp> billion (<year>), growth <growth>%, population <population> (<year>); capital <capital>, currency <currency> (<code>).'
Finish the draft (in the recording the user clicked Discard every time, not Send)

opportunities.name: Log a classic book to reading notes
opportunities.description: Search Project Gutenberg for a book title, open its page to get the release date and download count, look up the author's lifespan on Wikipedia, and add a 'Read: <title> by <author> (<lifespan>), Gutenberg since <date>, <downloads> downloads' entry to the Notes app.
steps: Open Project Gutenberg and type the book title in Quick search, then click Go
Scroll to the bibliographic record and read the Release Date and Downloads count
Open Wikipedia, search the author's name and read the birth and death years
Open the Notes page and click the 'New note' field
Type 'Read: <title> by <author> (<birth>-<death>), Gutenberg since <release date>, <downloads> downloads' and save it
